# DISS Restoration

> 24/7 restoration services in Youngstown, OH.

DISS Restoration (DISS Restoration) is a professional restoration contractor serving Youngstown, OH and surrounding areas since 2021. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (724) 981-1441 · Email: info@dissrestoration.com.
